name: Citizenship by Registration -- Marriage

qualifying_event.description: The spouse of an Antiguan and Barbudan citizen who has been married to and living with the citizen for at least 3 years may register for citizenship.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of the citizen spouse's nationality; proof of continuous cohabitation for at least 3 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being married to, and living with, an Antiguan and Barbudan citizen for a minimum of 3 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of marriage and cohabitation with the citizen spouse.

evidence_required.document: Registration application form (form not itemised in the sources reviewed)

sources.title: Wikipedia -- Antiguan and Barbudan nationality law: registration for citizenship by spouses of nationals married and living together for a minimum of 3 years

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Antigua and Barbuda's initial build. STATUS: DRAFT for the same reason as ag_citizenship_by_descent.json -- this hard requirement is sourced only to a tier-4 secondary summary of the Citizenship Act, with no gov.ag registration-for-citizenship page or primary legislative text retrieved in this pass (the Immigration Department's own FAQs cover the Resident Permit's 1-year marriage ground -- see ag_resident_permit_marriage.json -- but not this separate, faster registration-for-citizenship track). Feeds from ag_resident_permit_marriage.json as a natural next step for a spouse who has already been married to and living with the citizen for the full 3 years, but is modelled as its own route since registration for citizenship is a distinct application from the Resident Permit itself.
